caseName: Cnty. of Maui v. Haw. Wildlife Fund
caseNameFull: COUNTY OF MAUI, HAWAII v. HAWAII WILDLIFE FUND

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States on or before 4 p.m., Friday, January 4, 2019.
